description: This Java class is a deserializer for JSON input related to credit bureau commands in the Fineract project. It validates and parses JSON data for create and update operations, ensuring correctness and adherence to expected parameters.

classes.name: CreditBureauCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A Spring component that deserializes and validates JSON commands for creating or updating credit bureau entities in the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a credit bureau, ensuring required fields are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a credit bureau, checking optional fields and their correctness.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors were collected during JSON validation.
